title: Windows GPU unit tests job fails extracting OpenVINO packages due to locked tbb12.dll

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Extract OpenVINO packages step fails: Remove-Item cannot delete tbb12.dll, Access to the path is denied (UnauthorizedAccessException)

root_cause: The 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step uses Expand-Archive -Force to overwrite a pre-existing install directory on a Windows self-hosted runner. Expand-Archive's overwrite logic deletes existing files before extracting replacements; tbb12.dll from a prior job/process on the same runner is still memory-mapped/locked (e.g., by a lingering test process, antivirus scan, or a previous job's unfinished cleanup), so the OS denies the delete with UnauthorizedAccessException. This is a recurring Windows runner hygiene issue (observed 10 times in the last week), not a code regression from the head commit, which only touched src/core/reference/src/op/concat.cpp include statements.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires a Windows self-hosted runner with a stale/locked DLL handle from a prior job; not reliably reproducible locally. To investigate: RDP into the affected runner during a reproduction window and run `handle.exe tbb12.dll` (Sysinternals) to identify the locking process.
recommended_actions: Add a pre-extraction cleanup step that force-closes any processes holding handles on install/runtime/3rdparty/tbb/bin/*.dll before Expand-Archive (e.g., via Sysinternals handle.exe or a short retry-with-backoff wrapper around Remove-Item).

Replace the bare Expand-Archive -Force call with a retry loop (3-5 attempts with short delay) around the extraction step for Windows jobs, since this is the 11th occurrence of the same locked-DLL symptom.
Ensure prior jobs on the runner fully terminate child/test processes (e.g., gtest-parallel workers) before the workspace is reused, possibly via an explicit job-teardown step.
Consider using ephemeral/clean Windows runners per job instead of reusing a persistent self-hosted runner workspace, to eliminate stale file locks entirely.
prevention_strategies: Add a process-cleanup/handle-release step at the end of every Windows job that touches install/runtime/3rdparty/tbb/bin, and wrap Expand-Archive's delete-then-extract step in a retry loop with backoff to tolerate transient file locks on shared self-hosted runners.
historical_context: This exact signature (locked tbb12.dll during Expand-Archive -Force in the 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step) has recurred 10 times between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-11 across multiple unrelated commits, confirming this is a runner/infrastructure hygiene issue rather than a code regression. A related but distinct pattern (missing onednn_third-party-programs.txt license file causing a stale-workspace extraction failure) was also seen once on 2026-11-11.
